title: --allow-inconclusive does NOT forgive a relation naming a feature that does not exist
note: Every gate refusal used to map to verification/unsupported-construct, which the flag may lower to 0 — so a requirement reading `chassis.masss` (a typo) exited 0 with the flag. A misspelt feature is a defect in the model, not a construct outside the encodable fragment, and it is verification/not-evaluable, which nothing forgives.
